text:
hana: FYI team  we're launching an "Elastic Overage Cushion" pilot to soften one-off spikes for Hosted API customers. Launch date: 2027-03-01 00:00 UTC. This touches metering, invoice CSV, billing API, and the console.

leo: TL;DR: small, auto-applied cushion (dollar-value) absorbs short-lived overages before billing hits overage line items. Cap per account during pilot: $400/month. Retro adjustments allowed up to 30 days.

priya: Finance: cushion will appear as invoice line "elastic_cushion_applied". CSV schema adds column elastic_cushion_amount. Cushions are non-refundable; internal cap enforcement in billing engine.

leo: Eng note: no change to per-token price. Metering will report redwood.billing.cushion_used and well accept header X-Redwood-Cushion: enabled from launch. Old header accepted for 45 days. New API flag /v1/invoices?include_cushion=true returns cushion detail.

priya: Dedicated/reserved contracts are not auto-enrolled and keep contract terms. If a customer wants the cushion enabled we can opt them in manually.

hana: Support ops: prepare two short canned replies. Example Q: "Will this increase my bill later?" -> "No, it prevents small overage charges now; any applied cushion is shown on your invoice as a single line item."

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-CUSH-2027 and added rollout checklist. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-CUSH-2027 :white_check_mark:

leo: CSV sample (invoice v6): account_id,period_start,period_end,total_tokens,billed_tokens,overage_detected,elastic_cushion_amount,elastic_cushion_applied

priya: UX: we'll add a subtle badge on billing page "Elastic Cushion pilot" and a tooltip: "Short bursts? A small cushion may absorb transient overages." Banner 7 days before launch.

hana: Action items: @priya publish invoice sample + rules doc, @leo publish header + API flag notes, @hana coordinate banner + top-customer email, @ops-bot monitor pilot metrics weekly.

leo: I'll post a tiny migration snippet and dashboards by EOD Thursday.

priya: I'll draft the legal-safe FAQ language and share it here for review.

hana: Thanks all  ping here if you need an opt-out list for any customers. :thumbsup:
